column1: Pengganti seluruh client Java: tanpa JVM dan tanpa mod Java.
column2: Replaces the whole Java client: no JVM and no Java mods.

column1: Diunduh otomatis saat PLAY pertama, sekitar 500 MiB.
column2: Downloaded automatically on the first PLAY, about 500 MiB.

column1: Satu-satunya versi yang dikerjakan mesin ini.
column2: The only version this engine supports.

column1: Pilihan di tab ini dipakai instance Rust saja dan berlaku pada PLAY berikutnya. Instance Vanilla, Fabric, dan Forge tidak terpengaruh.
column2: Choices on this tab are used by Rust instances only and take effect on the next PLAY. Vanilla, Fabric and Forge instances are not affected.

column1: Kompatibel paling aman untuk semua HP. Vulkan cepat memakai batching GPU. OpenGL ES masih eksperimental.
column2: Compatible is the safest on every phone. Fast Vulkan uses GPU batching. OpenGL ES is still experimental.

column1: Menurunkan resolusi render membuat game lebih ringan, gambar jadi lebih buram.
column2: Lowering the render resolution makes the game lighter, but the picture gets blurrier.

column1: Permintaan ke Android, bukan batas FPS game. Laju yang tidak didukung layar bisa diabaikan.
column2: A request to Android, not an FPS cap. A rate the screen does not support may be ignored.

column1: Memberi tahu Android bahwa game butuh performa stabil. Hanya berguna di HP yang mendukungnya.
column2: Tells Android the game needs steady performance. Only useful on phones that support it.

column1: Batas pekerja yang membuat dan merakit chunk, bukan semua utas aplikasi. Nilai kecil mengurangi beban CPU tetapi memuat dunia lebih lambat.
column2: Limits the workers that generate and assemble chunks, not every app thread. A small value lowers CPU load but loads the world more slowly.

column1: Suara yang sudah didekode (80%) dan buffer mesh kosong (20%), dibuat ulang dengan kualitas sama. Bukan batas total RAM atau VRAM. Nilai kecil bisa menambah kerja CPU.
column2: Decoded sounds (80%) and empty mesh buffers (20%), recreated at the same quality. Not a limit on total RAM or VRAM. A small value can add CPU work.

column1: Arah layar saat bermain. Bawaannya landscape.
column2: The screen orientation while playing. Landscape by default.

column1: Membatasi tampilan game ke rasio tertentu. Asli mengikuti rasio layar HP.
column2: Limits the game view to a set ratio. Native follows the phone's screen ratio.

column1: Menyembunyikan bilah navigasi dan bilah status saat bermain.
column2: Hides the navigation and status bars while playing.

column1: Menggeser tampilan game agar tidak tertutup lubang kamera atau poni.
column2: Shifts the game view so the camera hole or notch does not cover it.

column1: Posisi, ukuran, dan tombol layar mengikuti editor kontrol Amber, jadi hanya ada satu set kontrol. Matikan untuk memakai kontrol bawaan mesin. Berlaku di PLAY berikutnya.
column2: The on-screen buttons follow the Amber control editor (position, size, and buttons), so there is only one set of controls. Turn it off to use the engine's own controls. Applies on the next PLAY.

column1: Otomatis memilih sendiri antara layar sentuh, keyboard dan mouse, atau gamepad sesuai yang terpasang.
column2: Auto picks between touch, keyboard and mouse, or a gamepad depending on what is connected.

column1: Kosongkan untuk bermain di dunia sendiri. Bila diisi, PLAY langsung masuk ke server ini.
column2: Leave empty to play in your own world. If filled in, PLAY joins this server directly.

column1: Mengembalikan semua pilihan di tab ini ke bawaan mesin. Instance dan dunia tidak disentuh.
column2: Puts every choice on this tab back to the engine defaults. Instances and worlds are not touched.
Rust settings were put back to the defaults.

column1: Normal memakai bawaan mesin. Super hemat menurunkan jarak render, partikel, awan, dan bayangan. Hemat baterai membatasi 60 FPS dengan VSync. FPS maksimum melepas batas FPS dan mematikan VSync. Mode ini mengubah pengaturan video game saat PLAY.
column2: Normal uses the engine defaults. Super saver lowers render distance, particles, clouds, and shadows. Battery saver caps at 60 FPS with VSync. Max FPS removes the FPS cap and turns VSync off. These modes change the game video settings on PLAY.

column1: Mematikan tekstur beranimasi, fade chunk, goyangan kamera saat berjalan, dan blur menu. Lebih ringan di HP lemah.
column2: Turns off animated textures, chunk fade, camera bobbing while walking, and menu blur. Lighter on weak phones.
